r25q_03de4560229f9c671b.explanation: Identity: the Lily Brooks over-33 review is the Brooks-Price delivery in over 33 (r25loc_684a63ec63f0caa8617d), the same delivery as the pavilion-end entry (r25loc_5f76e32108d0e191fcea), which is filed under the 16:12 signal review in pavilion folio 38 (r26bridge_207c39e75749a7c16745), linked to the signed scorer sheet at folio 38, row 20 (r26bridge_e95db6813970044ea2fc), carried forward as pre-lock ledger cell 38/20-Q (r26bridge_882d25895a6a9f4a66e5); the parallel Price review in over 34 and the parallel Shaw review in over 21 are separate incidents and are not borrowed. For this delivery: the bowler's-end umpire signalled No ball (initial_call_set=NO_BALL_ONLY, effective_delivery_status=NO_BALL, not counting in the over per Law 21.16); the ball touched neither bat nor person (observed_contact=NONE); 1 completed run preceded the terminal event (movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance=1) and no boundary allowance is recorded (boundary_allowance=0). Wicket event: the umpire signal sheet records that the boundary resulted from a fielder's throw at the wicket, and the innings-control note records that the batters had crossed when the throw left the fielder; the striker was out of ground, the wicket was put down fairly, the ball was in play, and the fielding side appealed before the next run-up and before Time, so Laws 38.1-38.2 with Laws 31.1/31.3 give dismissal=RUN_OUT (permitted after a No ball under Law 22.9); pre_wicket_ball_state=LIVE. Scoring: the 1 completed run is scored as BATTER runs (no contact, so not a Leg bye under the contact-classification law), plus the 1 No-ball extra: BATTER=1, NO_BALL_EXTRA=1, total_runs=2; the bowler is debited batter runs plus the No-ball extra = 2. Counterfactual (single change): the batters had NOT crossed when the throw left the fielder; Run out still stands (crossing affects only overthrow run credit under Law 19.8, and no overthrow boundary is involved), so dismissal=RUN_OUT and the delivery stays a NO_BALL not counting in the over; the completed run and No-ball extra are unchanged: BATTER=1, NO_BALL_EXTRA=1, bowler_runs=2, total_runs=2; all other state fields are unchanged.

r25q_5d6660d0423190d267.explanation: Identity: the Sophie Blake over-20 review is the Blake-Shaw delivery in over 20 (r25loc_2725bc04d4ec925e9068), which is the same delivery as the pavilion-end entry (r26bridge_93d64469368ef758c5c2); the parallel Moore review in over 27 and the parallel Bennett review in over 15 are separate incidents and are not borrowed. For this delivery: the striker's-end umpire signalled Wide (initial_call_set=WIDE_ONLY, effective_delivery_status=WIDE, not counting in the over per Law 22.8); the ball touched neither bat nor person (observed_contact=NONE); no completed runs or boundary are recorded, so movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance=0 and boundary_allowance=0, and the only score is the Wide extra per Laws 22.6-22.7: WIDE_EXTRA=1, bowler debited 1 (Wide extra), total 1. Wicket event: the sheet required a choice between Stumped and Run out; the fielding side appealed before the next run-up and before Time (Laws 31.1/31.3 satisfied); the striker was out of ground and was NOT attempting a run; the wicket was put down fairly by the wicket-keeper alone. Law 39.1 is therefore fully satisfied, and Stumped is permitted after a Wide under Law 22.9, so dismissal=STUMPED; the ball was in play at the wicket, so pre_wicket_ball_state=LIVE. Counterfactual (single change): the striker WAS attempting a run; the not-attempting-a-run limb of Law 39.1 fails, so Stumped is unavailable, but Run out survives a Wide under Law 22.9 and Laws 38.1-38.2 are met (ball in play, batter out of ground, wicket fairly put down, appeal made), so dismissal becomes RUN_OUT; delivery status, scoring (WIDE_EXTRA=1, bowler_runs=1, total_runs=1) and all other state fields are unchanged.

r25q_c8f34a28b50497329e.explanation: Identity: the Zoe Turner over-26 review is the Turner-Moore delivery in over 26 (r25loc_4bfa2f358dc45b002d91), the same delivery as the pavilion-end entry (r25loc_d49d3e19f671592e38b7), which is filed under the 14:53 signal review in pavilion folio 12 (r26bridge_ccc300c2860cf033628a); the parallel Moore review in over 27 is a separate incident and is not borrowed. For this delivery: no No-ball or Wide signal is recorded, so initial_call_set=NONE and the delivery is LEGAL and counts in the over; the ball touched the striker's bat (observed_contact=BAT); the fielding side appealed before the next run-up and before Time; the wicket was put down fairly while the ball was still in play and the batter was out of ground, but the review-room audio log confirms the ball was already dead when the wicket was broken. Under the embedded Laws 20.1 and 20.6, once the ball is dead a later broken wicket cannot create a dismissal, so dismissal=NONE and pre_wicket_ball_state=DEAD. Scoring: 1 completed run preceded the terminal event and no boundary allowance is recorded, so BATTER=1 (credited to the striker under the scoring law), bowler_runs=1, total_runs=1, movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance=1, boundary_allowance=0. Counterfactual (single change): the ball was already dead before the wicket was broken is the active observation being changed, so it is replaced by its complement - the ball was still in play (live) when the wicket was broken, matching the recorded signal-sheet fact; with the ball live, the fair wicket put down while the striker was out of ground and the valid appeal make this a Stumped under Law 39.1 (non-No-ball delivery, keeper-only put down, no other fielder's intervention); the completed run before the wicket still scores, so BATTER=1, bowler_runs=1, total_runs=1; delivery stays LEGAL and all other state fields are unchanged except pre_wicket_ball_state=LIVE.

r25q_dac4d9ea797c8631a1.explanation: Identity: the match-control index equates the Hannah Cole over-34 review with the Cole-Hayes delivery in over 34 (r26bridge_55be248e0106ff8a66b6); the parallel Price review in over 34 and pre-lock cell 38/20-Q are separate incidents and are not borrowed. For this delivery: no No-ball or Wide signal is recorded, so initial_call_set=NONE and the delivery is LEGAL and counts in the over; the signed delivery worksheet records bat contact (observed_contact=BAT); the umpire signal sheet gives an agreed boundary allowance of 4 and confirms the boundary came directly from the delivery, not an overthrow, so no completed running runs are added (movement_runs_before_boundary_allowance=0). Under the embedded scoring law, runs from a ball struck by the bat are credited to the striker: BATTER=4, no extras, bowler debited 4 (batter runs only), total 4, ledger balances. No wicket event is recorded, so pre_wicket_ball_state=NOT_APPLICABLE and dismissal=NONE. Counterfactual (single change): the agreed boundary allowance becomes 6; every other resolved fact and source selection is preserved, so the delivery stays LEGAL with bat contact and no overthrow, giving BATTER=6, bowler_runs=6, total_runs=6; all state fields except boundary_allowance are unchanged.

r25q_fef23ec11ccb5c6c3b.explanation: Identity: the Ella Foster over-14 review is the Foster-Bennett delivery in over 14 (r25loc_b47aea1d3b1869deaadd), the same delivery as the pavilion-end entry (r25loc_d7687aa3b095f7593599), which is filed under the 18:58 signal review in pavilion folio 15 (r26bridge_f6bea16b2ddf4cb8be8f); the parallel Shaw review in over 21 is a separate incident and is not borrowed. For this delivery: no No-ball or Wide signal is recorded, so initial_call_set=NONE and the delivery is LEGAL and counts in the over; the ball touched the striker's bat (observed_contact=BAT); the fielding side appealed before the next run-up and before Time (Laws 31.1/31.3 satisfied); the ball did not touch the ground before control was complete and the fielder ultimately controlled both ball and movement, with no boundary contact before control, so Laws 33.1-33.3 are satisfied and dismissal=CAUGHT. Scoring: a four-run boundary allowance was agreed and the boundary came directly from the delivery (not an overthrow), so BATTER=4 under the striker-credit and agreed-allowance laws; bowler_runs=4; total_runs=4; no wicket event is recorded, so pre_wicket_ball_state=NOT_APPLICABLE. Counterfactual (single change): the fielder touched the boundary while carrying the ball before completing control, i.e. boundary grounding before completion, which under Laws 33.1-33.3 prevents a fair catch; with no other observation changed there is no alternative dismissal (no run-out facts and no stated wicket put down), so dismissal becomes NONE; the delivery remains LEGAL and, as the ball struck the bat and crossed the boundary, the agreed 4-run allowance still scores: BATTER=4, bowler_runs=4, total_runs=4; all other state fields are unchanged.
